name: Vector Cross Product Encoding
description: Translates the equality constraint into a linear algebra condition by mapping the scalar multipliers to 3D configuration vectors $(1, f, f^2)$. The proximity constraint is violated if their cross product is the zero vector. This mathematically evaluates to exactly $f_u = f_v$, but visually resembles a continuous physics or spatial geometry problem, disrupting models that rely on surface-level keyword matching to identify graph coloring.
